dang po ni <rs type="person" ref="db:3786" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">lo tsha ba</rs> na re mkhyen pa gsum 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rgyud la skye ba shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu yin la | nyams su len pa'i rgyu sbyor ba bzhi dang | de'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku ni nyams su len pa po'i rgyud dang 'brel pas skra rtse'i tshad tsam yin pas rgya che bar chung pa 'dus pa'i <lb n="5a2"/> phyir ro zhes zer ro |</seg></TEI>
